question: What great attainment of enjoyment and liberation makes one dear to the yoginis?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation form a combined attainment.
This attainment is described as a great accomplishment.
Such accomplishment brings favor with the yoginis.
inference: One who attains great enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginis.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginis through the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation.
